scope: Clean, idle logical Postgres reconstruction with schema-shape, version, and workload-mix retained verifier artifacts; active sessions, dirty WAL, and physical data-dir copy remain refused.
promotionEffect: Raises Postgres product support to 40%; broad service/workload support and arbitrary Linux process restore stay 0%.

proofs.proves: single-table primary-key, foreign-key join, and index/sequence schema shapes restore through target-native verification
proofs.claimUse: raises Postgres product support from 20% toward 40% for the clean logical subset
proofs.next: Add extension and larger schema rows before any 60% claim.

proofs.proves: PostgreSQL 14, 15, and 16 clean logical fixtures restore with retained verifier output
proofs.claimUse: keeps the 40% product-support claim from being a single-version proof
proofs.next: Add patch-version and extension-version variation before any 60% claim.

proofs.proves: read-only lookup, committed write batch, and aggregate-query workloads restore from clean logical state
proofs.claimUse: adds workload variety while active sessions and dirty WAL remain refused
proofs.next: Add larger dataset and failure-mode workload rows before any 60% claim.

proofs.proves: every 40% claim row retains source verifier, target verifier, restore summary, manifest, and dump hashes
proofs.claimUse: makes the 40% product-support claim auditable instead of metadata-only
proofs.next: Define a 60% gate with new retained verifier artifacts.
